verses.1:1: Now King David was old, advanced in days, and they kept covering him with garments, yet he did not grow warm.
verses.1:2: And his servants said, "Let them search for a young virgin woman for the king, and she will stand before the king and keep him warm, and she will lie with him, and my lord the king will grow warm."
verses.1:3: And they searched for a beautiful young woman from all the territory of Israel, and they found Abishag the Shunammite and brought her to the king.
verses.1:4: And the young woman was exceedingly beautiful; and she was keeping the king warm and serving him, yet the king did not know her.
verses.1:5: Now Adonijah son of Haggith was exalting himself, saying, "I will be king." And he prepared for himself chariots and horsemen, and fifty men to run before him.
verses.1:6: And his father had never restrained him, saying, "Why have you done this?" And moreover, he himself was very handsome in appearance, and she bore him after Absalom.
verses.1:7: And his words were with Joab the son of Zeruiah and with Abiathar the priest, and they gave help, following Adonijah.
verses.1:8: But Zadok the priest, and Benaiah son of Jehoiada, and Nathan the prophet, and Shimei, and Resei, and the mighty sons of David were not following Adonijah.
verses.1:9: And Adonijah sacrificed sheep and calves and lambs by Aithe of Zoheleth, which was next to Rogel, and he invited his brothers and the prominent men of Judah, servants of the king.
verses.1:10: But he did not invite Nathan the prophet, or Benaiah, or the mighty men, or Solomon his brother.
verses.1:11: And Nathan spoke to Bathsheba, the mother of Solomon, saying, "Have you not heard that Adonijah son of Haggith has become king, and our lord David does not know?
verses.1:12: And now, come, please let me give you counsel, and rescue your life and the life of your son Solomon.
verses.1:13: Come, go in to King David and speak to him, saying, 'Did you not, my lord the king, swear to your maidservant, saying, "Your son Solomon will be king after me, and he himself will sit on my throne"? And why has Adonijah become king?'
verses.1:14: And look, while you are still speaking there with the king, I also will come in afterward and complete your words."
verses.1:15: So Bathsheba went in to the king into the inner chamber. Now the king was very old, and Abishag the Shunammite was serving the king.
verses.1:16: And Bathsheba bowed and paid homage to the king. And the king said, "What is the matter with you?"
verses.1:17: And she said, "Lord, you swore by your God to your maidservant, saying, 'Your son Solomon will be king after me, and he will sit on my throne.'
verses.1:18: And now, look, Adonijah has become king, and you, my lord the king, do not know.
verses.1:19: And he has sacrificed calves and lambs and sheep in abundance, and has invited all the sons of the king, and Abiathar the priest, and Joab the commander of the army, yet he has not invited Solomon your servant.
verses.1:20: And as for you, my lord the king, the eyes of all Israel are toward you, to tell them who will sit on the throne of my lord the king after him.
verses.1:21: And it will be, when my lord the king sleeps with his fathers, that I and Solomon my son will be offenders."
verses.1:22: And look, while she was still speaking with the king, Nathan the prophet came.
verses.1:23: And it was reported to the king, "Here is Nathan the prophet." And he went in before the king and paid homage to the king with his face to the ground.
verses.1:24: And Nathan said, "My lord the king, did you say, 'Adonijah will be king after me, and he himself will sit on my throne'?
verses.1:25: For he has gone down today and has sacrificed calves and lambs and sheep in abundance, and has invited all the sons of the king, and the commanders of the army, and Abiathar the priest; and look, they are eating and drinking before him, and they have said, 'May King Adonijah live!'
verses.1:26: Yet he has not invited me myself, your servant, or Zadok the priest, or Benaiah son of Jehoiada, or Solomon your servant.
verses.1:27: Has this matter come about through my lord the king, and you have not made known to your servant who will sit on the throne of my lord the king after him?"
verses.1:28: And David answered and said, "Call Bathsheba to me." And she came in before the king and stood before him.
verses.1:29: And the king swore and said, "As the Lord lives, who has redeemed my life from all distress,
verses.1:30: just as I swore to you by the Lord, the God of Israel, saying, 'Solomon your son will be king after me, and he himself will sit on my throne in my place,' so indeed I will do on this day."
verses.1:31: And Bathsheba bowed with her face to the ground, and paid homage to the king, and said, "May my lord King David live forever!"
verses.1:32: And King David said, "Call Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah son of Jehoiada to me." And they came in before the king.
verses.1:33: And the king said to them, "Take the servants of your lord with you, and mount my son Solomon on my own mule, and bring him down to Gihon.
verses.1:34: And anoint him there, Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet, as king over Israel, and blow the horn and say, 'May King Solomon live!'
verses.1:35: And he will sit on my throne and be king in my place, and I have commanded that he be ruler over Israel and Judah."
verses.1:36: And Benaiah son of Jehoiada answered the king and said, "May it be so! May the God of my lord the king thus confirm it.
verses.1:37: Just as the Lord was with my lord the king, so may He be with Solomon, and may He make his throne greater than the throne of my lord King David."
verses.1:38: And Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites went down, and they seated Solomon on the mule of King David and led him to Gihon.
verses.1:39: And Zadok the priest took the horn of oil from the tent and anointed Solomon. And he blew the horn, and all the people said, "May King Solomon live!"
verses.1:40: And all the people went up after him, and they were dancing in dances and rejoicing with great joy; and the earth split open at their sound.
verses.1:41: And Adonijah and all his invited guests heard it, and they had finished eating. And Joab heard the sound of the horn and said, "What is the sound of the city roaring?"
verses.1:42: While he was still speaking, look, Jonathan son of Abiathar the priest came in. And Adonijah said, "Come in, for you are a man of valor; and bring good news."
verses.1:43: And Jonathan answered and said, "Indeed, our lord King David has made Solomon king;
verses.1:44: and the king sent with him Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites, and they seated him on the mule of the king;
verses.1:45: and Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anointed him at Gihon, and they went up from there rejoicing, and the city roared. This is the sound that you heard.
verses.1:46: And Solomon sat on the throne of the kingdom,
verses.1:47: and the servants of the king went in to bless our lord King David, saying, 'May God make the name of Solomon better than your name, and make his throne greater than your throne.' And the king bowed in worship on the bed,
verses.1:48: and moreover the king spoke thus: 'Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, who has given today one from my seed sitting on my throne, and my eyes see it.'"
verses.1:49: And all the invited guests of Adonijah rose up, and went, each man his own way.
verses.1:50: And Adonijah was afraid of Solomon, and he arose and went away and took hold of the horns of the altar.
verses.1:51: And it was reported to Solomon, saying, "Look, Adonijah is afraid of King Solomon, and he is holding onto the horns of the altar, saying, 'Let King Solomon swear to me today that he will not put his servant to death with the sword.'"
verses.1:52: And Solomon said, "If he proves to be a son of valor, not one of his hairs will fall to the ground; but if wickedness is found in him, he will be put to death."
verses.1:53: And King Solomon sent, and brought him down from the altar. And he came in and paid homage to King Solomon, and Solomon said to him, "Go to your house."
verses.2:1: And the days of David drew near for him to die, and he answered Solomon his son, saying,
verses.2:2: "I am going in the way of all the earth; and you shall be strong and become a man,
verses.2:3: and you shall keep the charge of your God, to walk in His ways, to keep His commandments and the statutes and the judgments that are written in the law of Moses, so that you will understand what you will do according to all that I may command you,
verses.2:4: so that the Lord may establish His word which He spoke, saying, 'If your sons keep their way, to walk before Me in truth with all their heart,' saying, 'a man will not be cut off for you from upon the throne of Israel.'
verses.2:5: And indeed you know all that Joab son of Zeruiah did to me, all that he did to the two commanders of the armies of Israel, to Abner son of Ner and to Amasa son of Jether, and he killed them and put the blood of war on his belt that was on his waist and on his sandal that was on his foot.
verses.2:6: And you shall act according to your wisdom, and you shall bring down his gray hair in peace to Hades.
verses.2:7: And to the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite you shall show mercy, and they will be among those who eat at your table; for in this way they drew near to me when I was fleeing from the presence of Absalom your brother.
verses.2:8: And look, with you is Shimei son of Gera, a son of the Jeminite from Bahurim; and he cursed me with a grievous curse on the day when I was going to the camps, and he came down to meet me at the Jordan, and I swore to him by the Lord, saying, 'I will not put you to death with the sword.'
verses.2:9: And you shall by no means hold him guiltless, for you are a wise man, and you will know what you will do to him; and you shall bring down his gray hair in blood to Hades."
verses.2:10: And David slept with his fathers, and he was buried in the city of David.
verses.2:11: And the days that David reigned over Israel were forty years; in Hebron he reigned seven years, and in Jerusalem thirty-three years.
verses.2:12: And Solomon sat on the throne of David his father, and his kingdom was greatly established.
verses.2:13: And Adonijah came in to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon and bowed down to her. And she said, "Is your coming in peace?" And he said, "Peace;
verses.2:14: I have a word for you." And she said to him, "Speak."
verses.2:15: And he said to her, "You know that the kingdom was mine, and upon me all Israel set its face to be king; and the kingdom turned around and became my brother's, for it became his from the Lord.
verses.2:16: And now I am asking one request from you; do not turn away your face." And Bathsheba said to him, "Speak."
verses.2:17: And he said to her, "Please speak to Solomon the king, for he will not turn away his face from you, and he will give me Abishag the Shunammite as a wife."
verses.2:18: And Bathsheba said, "Very well, I will speak about you to the king."
verses.2:19: And Bathsheba went in to King Solomon to speak to him about Adonijah. And the king rose up to meet her and kissed her, and he sat on the throne; and a throne was set for the mother of the king, and she sat at his right hand.
verses.2:20: And she said to him, "I am asking one small request from you; do not turn away your face." And the king said to her, "Ask, my mother, and I will not turn you away."
verses.2:21: And she said, "Please let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah your brother as a wife."
verses.2:22: And Solomon the king answered and said to his mother, "And why have you asked for Abishag for Adonijah? Ask for him the kingdom also, for he is my brother who is older than me, and he has Abiathar the priest, and he has Joab the son of Zeruiah, the chief commander, as a companion."
verses.2:23: And King Solomon swore by the Lord, saying, "May God do so to me, and so also may He add, for Adonijah has spoken this word against his own life.
verses.2:24: And now, as the Lord lives, who established me and set me on the throne of David my father, and He made a house for me just as the Lord spoke, surely today Adonijah will be put to death."
verses.2:25: And Solomon the king sent by the hand of Benaiah son of Jehoiada, and he killed him, and Adonijah died on that day.
verses.2:26: And to Abiathar the priest the king said, "Go off to Anathoth, to your field, for you are a man of death on this day; yet I will not put you to death, because you carried the ark of the covenant of the Lord before my father, and because you were afflicted in all things in which my father was afflicted."
verses.2:27: And Solomon cast out Abiathar from being a priest of the Lord, so that the word of the Lord might be fulfilled, which He spoke against the house of Eli in Shiloh.
verses.2:28: And the report came to Joab the son of Zeruiah, for Joab had turned after Adonijah, and he had not turned after Absalom; and Joab fled into the tabernacle of the Lord and took hold of the horns of the altar.
verses.2:29: And it was reported to Solomon, saying, "Joab has fled into the tent of the Lord, and look, he is holding on to the horns of the altar." And Solomon sent to Joab, saying, "What has happened to you, that you have fled to the altar?" And Joab said, "Because I was afraid of your presence, and I fled to the Lord." And Solomon sent Benaiah son of Jehoiada, saying, "Go and kill him, and bury him."
verses.2:30: And Benaiah son of Jehoiada came into the tent of the Lord and said to him, "Thus says the king, 'Come out.'" And Joab said, "I am not going out, for here I will die." And Benaiah son of Jehoiada returned and spoke to the king, saying, "This is what Joab has spoken, and this is what he has answered me."
verses.2:31: And the king said to him, "Go and do to him just as he has said, and kill him and you shall bury him; and you shall remove today the blood which he shed without cause from me and from the house of my father.
verses.2:32: And the Lord has returned the blood of his unrighteousness upon his own head; and he fell upon the two men more righteous and better than himself and killed them with the sword, and my father David did not know of their blood: Abner son of Ner, chief commander of Israel, and Amasa son of Jether, chief commander of Judah.
verses.2:33: And his blood has returned upon his own head and upon the head of his seed forever; and to David and to his seed and to his house and to his throne may there be peace forever from the Lord."
verses.2:34: And Jehoiada fell upon Joab and put him to death; and he buried him in his house in the wilderness.
verses.2:35: And the king appointed Benaiah son of Jehoiada in his place over the army command; and the kingdom was being set in order in Jerusalem. And Zadok the priest, the king appointed him as first priest in place of Abiathar. And the Lord gave discernment to Solomon, and very great wisdom, and breadth of heart like the sand that is beside the sea. And the discernment of Solomon was multiplied beyond all ancient sons and beyond all the discerning men of Egypt. And he took the daughter of Pharaoh, and he brought her into the city of David until he finished the house of the Lord first and the wall of Jerusalem all around; in seven years he made and finished it. And Solomon had seventy thousand bearing a burden and eighty thousand stonecutters in the mountain. And Solomon made the sea and the supports and the great basins and the pillars and the fountain of the courtyard and the bronze sea. And he built the citadel, a battlement upon it. He cut through the city of David. Thus the daughter of Pharaoh went up from the city of David to her house which he had built for her. Then he built the citadel. And Solomon offered up three times in the year burnt offerings and peace offerings on the altar which he had built to the Lord, and he burned incense before the Lord. And he finished the house. And these were the officials appointed over the works of Solomon: three thousand six hundred overseers of the people who were doing the works. And he built Hazor and Magao and Gezer and Upper Beth-horon and Baalath. However, after he built the house of the Lord and the wall of Jerusalem all around, after these things he built these cities. And while David was still living, he commanded Solomon, saying, "Look, with you is Shimei son of Gera, a son of the seed of the Jeminite from Hebron. This man cursed me with a grievous curse on the day when I was going to the camps; and he came down to meet me at the Jordan, and I swore to him by the Lord, saying, 'He will not be put to death with the sword.' And now do not hold him guiltless, for you are a discerning man, and you will know what you will do to him; and you shall bring down his gray hair in blood to Hades."
verses.2:36: And the king called Shimei and said to him, "Build a house for yourself in Jerusalem and stay there, and you shall not go out from there anywhere.
verses.2:37: And it will be on the day of your going out, when you cross the brook Kidron, you will certainly know that you will certainly die; your blood will be on your head." And the king put him under oath on that day.
verses.2:38: And Shimei said to the king, "Good is the word that you have spoken, my lord the king; so your servant will do." And Shimei stayed in Jerusalem three years.
verses.2:39: And it happened after the three years that two servants of Shimei ran away to Achish son of Amesa, king of Gath. And it was reported to Shimei, saying, "Look, your servants are in Gath."
verses.2:40: And Shimei rose up and saddled his donkey and went to Gath to Achish, to seek out his servants; and Shimei went and brought his servants from Gath.
verses.2:41: And it was reported to Solomon, saying, "Shimei went from Jerusalem to Gath and brought back his servants."
verses.2:42: And the king sent and called Shimei and said to him, "Did I not put you under oath by the Lord and solemnly warn you, saying, 'On whatever day you go out from Jerusalem and go to the right or to the left, you will certainly know that you will certainly die'?
verses.2:43: And why is it that you did not keep the oath of the Lord and the command which I commanded against you?"
verses.2:44: And the king said to Shimei, "You know all your wickedness which your heart has known, the things that you did to David my father; and the Lord has repaid your wickedness upon your head.
verses.2:45: And King Solomon is blessed, and the throne of David will be established before the Lord forever."
verses.2:46: And King Solomon commanded Benaiah son of Jehoiada, and he went out and killed him. And King Solomon was exceedingly discerning and wise; and Judah and Israel were very many, like the sand that is by the sea in multitude, eating and drinking and rejoicing. And Solomon was ruling over all the kingdoms, and they were bringing gifts and serving Solomon all the days of his life. And Solomon began to open the dominions of Lebanon; and he himself built Thermai in the wilderness. And this was the meal for Solomon: thirty kors of fine flour and sixty kors of pounded meal, ten choice calves and twenty pasture-fed oxen and one hundred sheep, besides deer and gazelles and choice pasture-fed fowl. Was he not ruling over everything beyond the river from Raphei to Gaza, over all the kings beyond the river? And he had peace on all his sides all around; and Judah and Israel lived confidently, each under his vine and under his fig tree, eating and drinking, from Dan even to Beersheba, all the days of Solomon. And these were the officials of Solomon: Azariah son of Zadok the priest; and Orniou son of Nathan, chief of those in charge, and he ran to his house; and Suba, scribe; and Basa son of Achithalam, recorder; and Abi son of Joab, chief commander; and Achire son of Edrai, over the burdens; and Benaiah son of Jehoiada, over the court administration and over the brickworks; and Kachour son of Nathan, the counselor. And Solomon had forty thousand brood mares for chariots, and twelve thousand horses; and he was ruling over all the kings from the river even to the land of the foreigners and to the borders of Egypt. Solomon son of David reigned over Israel and Judah in Jerusalem.
verses.3:2: Burning incense on the high places, because a house had not been built for the Lord until now.
verses.3:3: And Solomon loved the Lord, walking in the statutes of David his father; only at the high places he was sacrificing and burning incense.
verses.3:4: And he arose and went to Gibeon to sacrifice there, because it was highest and great; Solomon offered up a thousand burnt offerings on the altar in Gibeon.
verses.3:5: And the Lord appeared to Solomon in sleep at night, and the Lord said to Solomon, "Ask some request for yourself."
verses.3:6: And Solomon said, "You showed great mercy to Your servant David my father, just as he walked before You in truth and in righteousness and in uprightness of heart with You, and You kept for him this great mercy, to set his son on his throne as it is this day.
verses.3:7: And now, Lord my God, You have given Your servant in place of David my father; and I am a small child, and I do not know my going out and my coming in.
verses.3:8: And Your servant is in the midst of Your people whom You have chosen, a numerous people who cannot be numbered.
verses.3:9: And give to Your servant a heart to hear and to judge Your people in righteousness, and to understand between good and evil; for who will be able to judge this weighty people of Yours?"
verses.3:10: And it was pleasing before the Lord that Solomon had asked for this thing.
verses.3:11: And the Lord said to him, "Because you have asked this thing from Me, and have not asked for yourself many days, and have not asked for wealth, nor have you asked for the lives of your enemies, but have asked for yourself understanding to hear judgment,
verses.3:12: look, I have carried out your word; look, I have given you a discerning and wise heart; there has been no one like you before you, and after you no one like you will arise.
verses.3:13: And what you did not ask for I have given you, both wealth and glory, so that there has not been a man like you among kings;
verses.3:14: and if you walk in My way to keep My commandments and My statutes, as David your father walked, then I will multiply your days."
verses.3:15: And Solomon awoke, and look, it was a dream. And he arose and came to Jerusalem, and he stood before the altar that was before the ark of the covenant of the Lord in Zion, and offered up burnt offerings and made peace offerings, and made a great banquet for himself and for all his servants.
verses.3:16: Then two women who were prostitutes appeared to the king and stood before him.
verses.3:17: And the one woman said, "Pardon me, lord, I and this woman live in one house, and we gave birth in the house.
verses.3:18: And it happened on the third day after I gave birth that this woman also gave birth. And we were together, and there is no one with us except the two of us in the house.
verses.3:19: And this woman's son died at night, since she lay upon him;
verses.3:20: and she arose in the middle of the night and took my son from my arms and laid him in her bosom, and her dead son she laid in my bosom.
verses.3:21: And I arose in the morning to nurse my son, and he was dead; and now, I examined him in the morning, and look, he was not my son whom I had borne."
verses.3:22: And the other woman said, "No, rather my son is the living one, and your son is the dead one." And they spoke before the king.
verses.3:23: And the king said to them, "You say, 'This is my son, the living one, and this woman's son is the dead one,' and you say, 'No, rather my son is the living one, and your son is the dead one.'"
verses.3:24: And the king said, "Fetch a sword." And they brought the sword before the king.
verses.3:25: And the king said, "Divide the living nursing child in two, and give half of him to this one and half of him to that one."
verses.3:26: And the woman whose son was the living one answered and spoke to the king, because her womb was stirred over her son, and she said, "Pardon me, lord, give her the child, and by no means put him to death." And the other said, "Let him be neither mine nor hers; divide him."
verses.3:27: And the king answered and said, "Give the child to the one who said, 'Give him to her, and by no means put him to death'; she is his mother."
verses.3:28: And all Israel heard this judgment that the king had judged, and they feared before the king, because they saw that the discernment of God was in him to do justice.
verses.4:1: And King Solomon was reigning over Israel.
verses.4:2: And these were the officials who were his: Azari son of Zadok,
verses.4:3: and Eliaph and Ahijah son of Saba, scribes, and Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud, recorder,
verses.4:5: and Ornia son of Nathan, over the deputies, and Zabud son of Nathan, companion of the king,
verses.4:6: and Ahi was steward, and Eliak the steward, and Eliab son of Saph, over the family, and Adoniram son of Ephra, over the taxes.
verses.4:7: And Solomon had twelve deputies over all Israel to supply the king and his household; a month in the year fell to each one to supply.
verses.4:8: And these are their names: Baior in the hill country of Ephraim, one;
verses.4:9: son of Rechas in Machemas and Bethalami and Beth-shemesh and Elon as far as Bethlaman, one;
verses.4:10: son of Hesed, Bernemalousamencha and Respharachein,
verses.4:11: throughout Dan and throughout Phathei, husband of Tablethei—a daughter of Solomon was his wife—one;
verses.4:12: Baccha son of Ahimach, Polamach and Megiddo, and all the house of Dan that is beside Sesathan below Esrae, and from Baisaphut, Abel-meholah as far as Maeber Lukam, one;
verses.4:13: son of Geber, Ramoth-gilead—to him belonged the region of Eretabam in Bashan, sixty great walled cities and bronze bars—one;
verses.4:15: Ahimaaz in Naphtali, and he took Basemath the daughter of Solomon, one;
verses.4:16: Baana son of Hushai in Maala, one;
verses.4:18: son of Adai in the land of Gad, the land of Sihon king of Heshbon and of Og king of Bashan; and one naseph in the land of Judah;
verses.4:19: Jehoshaphat son of Phuasud in Issachar.
verses.5:1: And thus the appointed officials supplied King Solomon, and all orders for the king's table, each one in his month; they do not deviate from a word. And they brought the barley and the straw for the horses and for the chariots to the place wherever the king might be, each one according to his assignment.
verses.5:2: And these were the requirements for Solomon in one day: thirty kors of fine flour and sixty kors of pounded meal,
verses.5:3: and ten choice calves and twenty pasture-fed oxen and one hundred sheep, besides deer and gazelles and choice birds, fattened.
verses.5:4: For he was ruler beyond the river, and he had peace from all sides all around.
verses.5:9: And the Lord gave discernment to Solomon, and exceedingly great wisdom, and vastness of heart like the sand beside the sea.
verses.5:10: And Solomon abounded exceedingly beyond the discernment of all ancient men and beyond all the discerning men of Egypt.
verses.5:11: And he was wiser than all men, and he was wiser than Gaithan the Zareite, and Ainan, and Chalkad, and Darala, son of Mal.
verses.5:12: And Solomon spoke three thousand proverbs, and his songs were five thousand.
verses.5:13: And he spoke about the trees, from the cedar that is in Lebanon even to the hyssop that comes out through the wall; and he spoke about the beasts, and about the birds, and about the creeping things, and about the fish.
verses.5:14: And all the peoples came to hear the wisdom of Solomon, and from all the kings of the earth, as many as heard of his wisdom. And Solomon took the daughter of Pharaoh for himself as a wife, and brought her into the city of David until he completed the house of the Lord, and his own house, and the wall of Jerusalem. When Pharaoh king of Egypt went up, he captured Gezer beforehand and burned it with fire, and the Canaanite dwelling in Mergab; and Pharaoh gave them as parting gifts to his daughter, Solomon's wife.
verses.5:15: And Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants to anoint Solomon in place of David his father, because Hiram loved David all the days.
verses.5:16: And Solomon sent to Hiram, saying,
verses.5:17: "You know David my father, that he was not able to build a house for the name of the Lord my God because of the wars that surrounded him, until he placed them under the soles of his feet.
verses.5:18: And now the Lord my God has given me rest all around; there is no adversary and there is no evil offense.
verses.5:19: And look, I say, 'I will build a house for the name of the Lord my God,' just as the Lord God spoke to David my father, saying, 'Your son, whom I will set in your place upon your throne, he will build the house for My name.'
verses.5:20: And now give command, and let them cut timber for me from Lebanon; and look, my servants will be with your servants; for your service I will give to you according to everything that you say, because you know that it is not possible for us on our own to cut timber like the Sidonians."
verses.5:21: And it came about, when Hiram heard the words of Solomon, that he rejoiced exceedingly and said, "Blessed be God today, who has given to David a discerning son over this numerous people."
verses.5:22: And he sent to Solomon, saying, "I have heard concerning everything that you have sent to me; I will do all your desire, cedar and pine timber.
verses.5:23: My servants will bring them down from Lebanon to the sea; I will set them as rafts as far as the place of which you send word to me, and I will cast them loose there, and you will take them away; and you will do my desire in giving bread to my household."
verses.5:24: And Hiram kept giving to Solomon cedars and all his desire.
verses.5:25: And Solomon gave to Hiram twenty thousand kors of wheat and macheir for his household, and twenty thousand baths of beaten oil; in this manner Solomon gave to Hiram year by year.
verses.5:26: And the Lord gave wisdom to Solomon, just as He spoke to him; and there was peace between Hiram and Solomon, and they made a covenant between themselves.
verses.5:27: And the king raised a levy also from all Israel, and the levy was thirty thousand men.
verses.5:28: And he sent them to Lebanon, ten thousand a month, alternating; a month they were in Lebanon and two months at their home; and Adoniram was over the levy.
verses.5:29: And Solomon had seventy thousand carrying burdens and eighty thousand stonecutters in the mountain,
verses.5:30: besides the officials appointed over the works of Solomon, three thousand six hundred overseers, who performed the works.
verses.5:32: And they prepared the stones and the timber for three years.
verses.6:1: And it came about in the four hundred and fortieth year of the departure of the sons of Israel from Egypt, in the fourth year, in the second month, while King Solomon was reigning over Israel, that they brought great, costly stones for the foundation of the house, and unhewn stones; and the sons of Solomon and the sons of Hiram hewed them and laid them. In the fourth year he laid the foundation of the house of the Lord, in the month of Niso and the second month. In the eleventh year, in the month of Baad (this is the eighth month), the house was completed in every detail of it and in every plan of it.
verses.6:2: And as for the house that the king built for the Lord, its length was forty, and its width was twenty by the cubit, and its height was twenty-five by the cubit.
verses.6:3: And the ailam in front of the temple was twenty by the cubit in its length, along the width of the house, in front of the house. And he built the house and completed it.
verses.6:4: And he made for the house slanted, hidden windows.
verses.6:5: And he placed chambers against the wall itself of the house, all around the temple and the dabir.
verses.6:6: The lowest side-story was five cubits by the cubit in its width, and the middle one six, and the third seven by the cubit in its width; for he put a setback on the house all around on the outside of the house, so that they would not take hold of the walls of the house.
verses.6:7: And the house, while it was being built, was built with quarried, unworked stones; and no hammer or axe or any iron tool was heard in the house while it was being built.
verses.6:8: And the entrance of the lowest side-story was under the right shoulder of the house, and there was a winding stairway to the middle story, and from the middle one to the third story.
verses.6:9: And he built the house and completed it; and he paneled the house with cedars.
verses.6:10: And he built the tie-frames throughout the whole house, five by the cubit in its height, and he held the joint together with cedar timbers.
verses.6:15: And he built the walls of the house with cedar timbers, from the floor of the house even to the beams and to the walls; he paneled it continuously with wood on the inside, and he overlaid the inside of the house with pine planks.
verses.6:16: And he built the twenty cubits from the end of the wall, the one side from the floor to the beams; and he made it from the dabir into the Holy of Holies.
verses.6:17: And the temple was forty cubits in front of the dabir, in the middle of the house on the inside,
verses.6:19: to place there the ark of the covenant of the Lord.
verses.6:20: Twenty cubits in length, and twenty cubits in width, and twenty cubits was its height.
verses.6:21: And he overlaid it with enclosed gold; and he made an altar in front of the dabir and overlaid it with gold.
verses.6:22: And he overlaid the entire house with gold, until the completion of the whole house.
verses.6:23: And he made in the dabir two cherubim, ten cubits in measured size.
verses.6:24: And its wing was five cubits; and the second was ten by the cubit from the end of its wing.
verses.6:25: Likewise for the second cherub, one finish in one measure; for both there was one finish.
verses.6:26: And the height of the cherub was by the cubit, and likewise the second cherub.
verses.6:27: And both cherubim were in the middle of the innermost house; and he spread out their wings, and one wing touched the wall, and a wing touched the second wall; and its wings that were in the middle of the house touched wing to wing.
verses.6:28: And he overlaid the cherubim with gold.
verses.6:29: He engraved all the walls of the house all around with a graving tool with carved cherubim, and palm trees in the inner and in the outer.
verses.6:30: And he overlaid the floor of the house with gold, of the innermost and of the outermost.
verses.6:31: And for the doorway of the dabir he made doors of juniper wood; porticoes, fourfold.
verses.6:34: In both doors there was pine wood: the one door was two leaves, and their pivots, and the second door was two leaves, pivoting.
verses.6:35: Carved cherubim and palm trees and outspread petals, and overlaid with gold brought down upon the carved relief.
verses.6:36: And he built the innermost court, three courses of unhewn stones and a course of worked cedar all around. And he built a curtain of the court of the ailam of the house that was in front of the temple.
verses.7:1: And King Solomon sent and fetched Hiram from Tyre,
verses.7:2: the son of a widowed woman, and he was from the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a Tyrian man, a craftsman of bronze and filled with skill and understanding and knowledge to do every work in bronze. And he was brought in to King Solomon, and he did all the works.
verses.7:3: And he cast the ailam of the house: eighteen cubits was the height of the pillar, and a circumference of fourteen cubits encircled it, the thickness of the pillar; the hollows were four fingers; and thus was the second pillar.
verses.7:4: And he made two cast capitals to put on the tops of the pillars; five cubits was the height of the one capital.
verses.7:5: And he made two lattices to cover over the capital of the pillars, both a lattice for the one capital and a lattice for the second capital.
verses.7:6: And hanging work, two rows of bronze pomegranates, latticed, hanging work, row upon row; and thus he did for the second capital.
verses.7:7: And he set up the pillars of the portico of the temple; and he set up the one pillar and called its name Jachum, and he set up the second pillar and called its name Balaz.
verses.7:8: And on the tops of the pillars was lily work by the portico, of four cubits.
verses.7:9: And a roof-beam was on both of the pillars, and above the sides the roof-beam was a capital, by the cubit.
verses.7:10: And he made the sea ten cubits from its wall to its brim, round all around, the same; five cubits was its height, and thirty-three cubits were gathered together.
verses.7:11: And supports underneath its brim all around encircled it, ten to a cubit all around.
verses.7:12: And its brim was like the work of the brim of a cup, a blossom of a lily, and its thickness was a handbreadth.
verses.7:13: And twelve oxen were underneath the sea, three looking north, and three looking west, and three looking south, and three looking east. And all the hindquarters were toward the house, and the sea was upon them above.
verses.7:14: And he made ten bronze stands; five cubits was the length of the one stand, and four cubits was its width, and six cubits was its height.
verses.7:15: And this was the work of the stands: they had an enclosure, and an enclosure between the projections.
verses.7:16: And on their enclosures between projections were lions and oxen and cherubim; and on the projections it was thus also above, and underneath the lions and the oxen were spaces, a work of descent.
verses.7:17: And there were four bronze wheels for the one stand, and the bronze attachments, and their four parts, shoulder-pieces underneath the washing basins.
verses.7:18: And there were axles in the wheels in the stand; and the height of the one wheel was a cubit and a half.
verses.7:19: And the work of the wheels was the work of chariot wheels; their axles and their rims and their workmanship were all cast.
verses.7:20: The four shoulder-pieces were on the four corners of the one stand; from the stand were its shoulders.
verses.7:21: And on the top of the stand, half a cubit was its size, round all around on the top of the stand; and there was a beginning of its handles and its enclosures; and it opened onto four beginnings of its handles.
verses.7:22: And its enclosures were cherubim and lions and palm trees standing, each one adjoining in front, inward, and the parts all around.
verses.7:23: According to it he made all the ten stands, one order and one measure for all.
verses.7:24: And he made ten bronze cauldrons, holding forty choes for the one cauldron by measure; the one cauldron was on the one stand, for the ten stands.
verses.7:25: And he set the five stands at the shoulder of the house on the left; and the sea was at the shoulder of the house on the right, toward the east, on the south side.
verses.7:26: And Hiram made the pots and the tongs and the bowls; and Hiram finished making all the works that he made for King Solomon in the house of the Lord:
verses.7:27: two pillars, and the two twisted bands of the pillars on the tops of the pillars, and the two lattices to cover both the twisted bands of the carvings that were on the pillars;
verses.7:28: the four hundred pomegranates for both the lattices, two rows of pomegranates for the one lattice to cover over both the twisted bands of the stand that were on both the pillars;
verses.7:29: and the ten stands, and the ten cauldrons on the stands;
verses.7:30: and the one sea, and the twelve oxen underneath the sea;
verses.7:31: and the pots and the tongs and the bowls and all the vessels that Hiram made for King Solomon for the house of the Lord. And the pillars of the house of the king and of the house of the Lord were forty-eight. Hiram made all the works of the king entirely of bronze.
verses.7:32: There was no weight of the bronze with which he made all these works because of the very great abundance; there was no limit to the weights of the bronze.
verses.7:33: In the region around the Jordan he cast them in the thickness of the earth, between Succoth and Seira.
verses.7:34: And King Solomon took the vessels that he made in the house: the golden altar, and the table on which were the loaves of the offering, of gold,
verses.7:35: and the lampstands, five on the left and five on the right in front of the inner sanctuary, of gold, enclosed, and the lamp-holders and the lamps and the oil-ladles, of gold;
verses.7:36: and the vestibules and the nails and the bowls and the dishes and the censers, of gold, enclosed; and the door-frames of the doors of the innermost house, the Holy of Holies, and the doors of the temple, of gold.
verses.7:37: And the work of the house of the Lord that Solomon did was completed; and Solomon brought in the holy things of David his father and all the holy things of Solomon; the silver and the gold he put into the treasuries of the house of the Lord.
verses.7:38: And for thirteen years Solomon built the house for himself.
verses.7:39: And he built the house with the forest of Lebanon: one hundred cubits was its length, and fifty cubits was its width, and it was of three rows of cedar pillars, and there were cedar shoulder-pieces for the pillars.
verses.7:40: And he paneled the house above upon the sides of the pillars; and the number of the pillars was forty-five to a row,
verses.7:41: and three roof-beams, and space facing space threefold.
verses.7:42: And all the door-frames and the spaces were square, roofed with beams, and from the door-frame to the door threefold.
verses.7:43: And the portico of the pillars was fifty in length and fifty in width, joined together, a portico in front of them; and there were pillars and a thickness in front of it for the porticos.
verses.7:44: And there was the portico of the thrones, where he would judge there, the portico of judgment.
verses.7:45: And their house, in the house he would dwell there, was one court out of one winding around these according to this work; and a house for the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Solomon took, like this portico.
verses.7:46: All these were of costly stones, chiseled at intervals on the inside, and from the foundation to the cornices, and on the outside to the great court,
verses.7:47: which was founded with large costly stones, ten-cubit stones and the eight-cubit ones,
verses.7:48: and above with costly ones according to the measure of unhewn stones, and with cedars.
verses.7:49: The circuits of the great court were three rows of unhewn stones and a row of joined cedar.
verses.7:50: And Solomon finished his whole house.
verses.8:1: And it happened, when Solomon finished building the house of the Lord and his own house after twenty years, then King Solomon assembled all the elders of Israel in Zion to bring the ark of the covenant of the Lord out of the city of David, which is Zion,
verses.8:3: And the priests lifted up the ark
verses.8:4: and the tent of testimony and the holy vessels that were in the tent of testimony.
verses.8:5: And the king and all Israel were before the ark, sacrificing sheep and oxen without number.
verses.8:6: And the priests brought the ark into its place, into the inner sanctuary of the house, into the Holy of Holies, under the wings of the cherubim.
verses.8:7: For the cherubim had their wings spread out over the place of the ark, and the cherubim covered over the ark and over its holy things from above,
verses.8:8: and the consecrated things extended out, and the heads of the consecrated things were visible from the holy place in front of the inner sanctuary, and they were not seen outside.
verses.8:9: There was nothing in the ark except two stone tablets, the tablets of the covenant which Moses placed at Horeb, which the Lord covenanted with the sons of Israel when they came out of the land of Egypt.
verses.8:10: And it happened, when the priests came out of the holy place, that the cloud filled the house;
verses.8:11: and the priests were not able to stand to minister on account of the cloud, for the glory of the Lord filled the house.
verses.8:14: And the king turned his face around, and the king blessed all Israel; and all the assembly of Israel was standing.
verses.8:15: And he said, "Blessed is the Lord God of Israel today, who spoke with His mouth concerning David my father and with His hands fulfilled it, saying,
verses.8:16: 'From the day I brought My people Israel out of Egypt, I did not choose a city in a single tribe of Israel to build a house for My name to be there; and I chose Jerusalem for My name to remain there, and I chose David to be over My people Israel.'
verses.8:17: And it was in the heart of my father to build a house for the name of the Lord God of Israel.
verses.8:18: And the Lord said to David my father, 'Because it came into your heart to build a house for My name, you did well that it was in your heart.
verses.8:19: You will not build the house; rather, your son who comes out from your sides, he will build the house for My name.'
verses.8:20: And the Lord established His word which He spoke; and I arose in place of David my father, and I sat on the throne of Israel just as He spoke, and I built the house for the name of the Lord God of Israel.
verses.8:21: And I set there a place for the ark, in which is the covenant of the Lord which the Lord made with our fathers when He brought them out of the land of Egypt."
verses.8:22: And Solomon stood up in front of the altar of the Lord, before all the assembly of Israel, and spread out his hands toward heaven,
verses.8:23: and said, "Lord God of Israel, there is no god like You in heaven above or on the earth below, keeping covenant and mercy for Your servant who walks before You with all his heart,
verses.8:24: which You kept for Your servant David my father; for indeed You spoke with Your mouth, and with Your hands You fulfilled it, as it is this day.
verses.8:25: And now, Lord God of Israel, keep for Your servant David my father what You spoke to him, saying, 'A man of yours will not be removed from My presence, sitting on the throne of Israel, if only your children keep their ways to walk before Me, just as you walked before Me.'
verses.8:26: And now, Lord God of Israel, please let Your word be confirmed to David my father.
verses.8:27: For will God truly dwell with people on the earth? If heaven and the heaven of heaven will not suffice for You, how much less even this house which I built for Your name?
verses.8:28: Yet You will look upon my supplication, Lord God of Israel, to hear the delight which Your servant prays before You, to You today,
verses.8:29: that Your eyes may be open toward this house day and night, toward the place of which You said, 'My name will be there,' to hear the prayer which Your servant prays toward this place day and night.
verses.8:30: And You will hear the supplication of Your servant and of Your people Israel, whatever they pray toward this place; and You will hear in the place of Your dwelling in heaven, and You will act and be merciful.
verses.8:31: In whatever way each one sins against his neighbor, and if he takes up a curse against him to place him under a curse, and he comes and confesses in front of Your altar in this house,
verses.8:32: then You will hear from heaven and act, and You will judge Your people Israel, so that the lawless one is declared lawless, putting his way upon his head, and to justify the righteous one, giving to him according to his righteousness.
verses.8:33: When Your people Israel stumble before enemies because they sin against You, and they turn back and confess to Your name, and pray and make supplication in this house,
verses.8:34: then You will hear from heaven and be merciful to the sins of Your servant Israel, and You will bring them back to the land which You gave to their fathers.
verses.8:35: When heaven is shut up and there is no rain because they sin against You, and they pray toward this place and confess to Your name, and turn back from their sins when You humble them,
verses.8:36: then You will hear from heaven and be merciful to the sins of Your servant and of Your people Israel; for You will show them the good way to walk in it, and You will give rain upon the land which You gave to Your servant as an inheritance.
verses.8:37: If there is famine, if there is death, when there is scorching, if there is locust or mildew, and if his enemy afflicts him in one of his cities, every misfortune, every pain,
verses.8:38: every prayer, every supplication that is made by any person, when each one knows the affliction of his heart and spreads out his hands toward this house,
verses.8:39: then You will hear from heaven, from Your prepared dwelling place, and be merciful, and You will act and give to a man according to his ways, just as You know his heart, for You alone know the heart of all the sons of men,
verses.8:40: so that they may fear You all the days that they live upon the land which You gave to our fathers.
verses.8:41: And concerning the foreigner who is not from Your people,
verses.8:42: when they come and pray toward this place,
verses.8:43: then You will hear from heaven, from Your prepared dwelling place, and act according to everything for which the foreigner calls upon You, so that all the peoples may know Your name and fear You, just as Your people Israel do, and know that Your name has been called upon this house which I built.
verses.8:44: When Your people go out to war against their enemies by the way in which You turn them, and they pray in the name of the Lord toward the city which You chose and the house which I built for Your name,
verses.8:45: then You will hear from heaven their supplication and their prayer, and You will execute justice for them.
verses.8:46: When they sin against You (for there is no person who will not sin), and You bring them and hand them over before enemies, and the captors take them captive to a land far or near,
verses.8:47: and they turn their hearts in the land where they were carried away, and they turn back in the land of their exile and make supplication to You, saying, 'We have sinned, we have done wrong, we have acted lawlessly,'
verses.8:48: and they turn back to You with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their enemies where You carried them away, and they pray to You toward their land which You gave to their fathers, the city which You chose, and the house which I have built for Your name,
verses.8:49: then You will hear from heaven, from Your prepared dwelling place,
verses.8:50: and be merciful to their wrongdoings by which they sinned against You and concerning all their transgressions by which they transgressed against You, and You will grant them compassion before those who hold them captive, and they will have compassion on them;
verses.8:51: for they are Your people and Your inheritance, whom You brought out of the land of Egypt, from the midst of an iron smelting furnace.
verses.8:52: And let Your eyes and Your ears be open to the supplication of Your servant and to the supplication of Your people Israel, to hear them in all things for which they call upon You.
verses.8:53: And You set them apart for Yourself as an inheritance from all the peoples of the earth, just as You spoke by the hand of Your servant Moses when You brought our fathers out of the land of Egypt, Lord, Lord." Then Solomon spoke concerning the house when he finished building it: "The Lord made known the sun in heaven; He said He would dwell in thick darkness. Build my house, a magnificent house for Yourself, to dwell in newness." Look, is this not written in the book of the song?
verses.8:54: And it happened, when Solomon finished praying to the Lord all this prayer and supplication, that he arose from in front of the altar of the Lord, having knelt on his knees with his hands spread out toward heaven.
verses.8:55: And he stood and blessed all the assembly of Israel with a loud voice, saying,
verses.8:56: "Blessed is the Lord today, who gave rest to His people Israel according to all that He spoke; not one word has failed among all His good words which He spoke by the hand of His servant Moses.
verses.8:57: May the Lord our God be with us, just as He was with our fathers; may He not forsake us nor turn away from us,
verses.8:58: to incline our hearts toward Him, to walk in all His ways and to keep all His commandments and His statutes which He commanded our fathers.
verses.8:59: And let these words, as I have made supplication before the Lord our God, be near to the Lord our God day and night, to execute justice for Your servant Israel, the matter of a day in the day of the year;
verses.8:60: so that all the peoples of the earth may know that the Lord God, He is God, and there is no other.
verses.8:61: And let our hearts be complete toward the Lord our God, and to walk devoutly in His statutes and to keep His commandments, as it is this day."
verses.8:62: And the king and all the sons of Israel offered a sacrifice before the Lord.
verses.8:63: And King Solomon offered the sacrifices of peace offerings which he offered to the Lord, twenty-two thousand oxen; and the king and all the sons of Israel dedicated the house of the Lord.
verses.8:64: On that day the king consecrated the middle of the courtyard that was in front of the house of the Lord; for there he offered the burnt offering and the sacrifices and the fat portions of the peace offerings, because the bronze altar that was before the Lord was too small to be able to hold the burnt offering and the sacrifices of the peace offerings.
verses.8:65: And Solomon held the feast on that day, and all Israel with him, a great assembly from the entrance of Hamath to the river of Egypt, before the Lord our God in the house which he built, eating and drinking and rejoicing before the Lord our God for seven days.
verses.8:66: And on the eighth day he sent the people away, and he blessed them, and each one went away to his tents rejoicing, and their heart was good over the good things which the Lord had done for David His servant and for Israel His people.
verses.9:1: And it happened, when Solomon finished building the house of the Lord and the house of the king, and all the undertaking of Solomon, all that he desired to do,
verses.9:2: that the Lord appeared to Solomon a second time, just as He had appeared in Gibeon,
verses.9:3: and the Lord said to him, "I have heard the voice of your prayer and your supplication which you have pleaded before Me. I have done for you according to all your prayer; I have consecrated this house which you have built, to place My name there forever, and My eyes will be there forever, and My heart all the days.
verses.9:4: And as for you, if you walk before Me just as David your father walked, in holiness of heart and in uprightness, and to do according to all that I commanded him, and keep My statutes and My commandments,
verses.9:5: then I will establish the throne of your kingdom over Israel forever, just as I spoke to David your father, saying, 'There will not be removed from you a man ruling in Israel.'
verses.9:6: But if you and your children indeed turn away from Me, and do not keep My commandments and My statutes which Moses set before you, and go and serve other gods and worship them,
verses.9:7: then I will remove Israel from the land which I gave them, and this house which I consecrated for My name I will cast away from My presence; and Israel will become a desolation and a byword among all the peoples.
verses.9:8: And this house will be the lofty one; everyone passing through it will be astonished and will hiss, and they will say, 'For what reason has the Lord done so to this land and to this house?'
verses.9:9: And they will say, 'Because they forsook the Lord their God, who brought their fathers out of Egypt, out of a house of slavery, and took hold of foreign gods and worshiped them and served them, therefore He brought this evil upon them.'" Then Solomon brought up the daughter of Pharaoh from the city of David to his house which he had built for himself in those days.
verses.9:10: For twenty years, in which Solomon built the two houses, the house of the Lord and the house of the king,
verses.9:11: Hiram king of Tyre assisted Solomon with cedar timbers and with pine timbers and with gold and with all his desire. Then the king gave to Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee.
verses.9:12: And Hiram went out from Tyre and traveled to Galilee to see the cities which Solomon had given him, and it did not please him.
verses.9:13: And he said, "What are these cities which you have given me, brother?" And he called them Border until this day.
verses.9:14: And Hiram brought to Solomon one hundred and twenty talents of gold.
verses.9:26: And King Solomon made a ship for himself in Ezion-geber, which is beside Elath on the shore of the farthest sea in the land of Edom.
verses.9:27: And Hiram sent in the ship some of his servants, seafaring men to row, who knew the sea, with the servants of Solomon.
verses.9:28: And they came to Sophera, and took from there one hundred and twenty talents of gold, and brought it to King Solomon.
verses.10:1: And the queen of Sheba heard of the name of Solomon and the name of the Lord, and she came to test him with riddles.
verses.10:2: And she came to Jerusalem with a very great force, and camels carrying spices and very much gold and precious stones. And she came in to Solomon and spoke to him all that was in her heart.
verses.10:3: And Solomon declared to her all her matters; there was not a matter overlooked by the king which he did not declare to her.
verses.10:4: And the queen of Sheba saw all the understanding of Solomon, and the house that he had built,
verses.10:5: and the food of Solomon, and the seating of his servants, and the standing of his ministers, and his apparel, and his cupbearers, and his burnt offering which he offered in the house of the Lord; and she was beside herself.
verses.10:6: And she said to King Solomon, "True is the word which I heard in my land concerning your word and concerning your understanding;
verses.10:7: and I did not believe those speaking to me until I arrived and my eyes have seen; and look, they are not half as they declared to me; you have added good things to them beyond all the report which I heard in my land.
verses.10:8: Blessed are your wives! Blessed are these servants of yours who stand before you continually, who hear all your understanding!
verses.10:9: May the Lord your God be blessed, who delighted in you to set you on the throne of Israel, because the Lord loves Israel to establish it forever; and He appointed you king over them to execute judgment in righteousness and in their judgments."
verses.10:10: And she gave to Solomon one hundred and twenty talents of gold, and very many spices, and precious stones; there never again came any in abundance like those spices which the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.
verses.10:11: And the ship of Hiram was carrying the gold from Suphir; it brought very many hewn timbers and precious stones.
verses.10:12: And the king made the hewn timbers into supports of the house of the Lord and of the house of the king, and harps and lyres for the singers; no such hewn timbers had come upon the earth, nor have they been seen anywhere until this day.
verses.10:13: And King Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all that she desired, whatever she asked, besides all that he had given her by the hand of King Solomon. And she turned back and went to her land, she and all her servants.
verses.10:14: And the weight of the gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred and sixty-six talents of gold,
verses.10:15: apart from the tributes of those subjected, of the merchants, and of all the kings of the region beyond, and of the satraps of the land.
verses.10:16: And Solomon made three hundred spears of beaten gold; three hundred gold pieces were upon each spear;
verses.10:17: and three hundred shields of beaten gold; and three minas of gold were in each shield. And he put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.
verses.10:18: And the king made a great ivory throne, and overlaid it with tested gold.
verses.10:19: The throne had six steps, and busts of calves were on the throne at its back, on this side and on that side at the place of the seat, and two lions standing beside the arms,
verses.10:20: and twelve lions standing on the six steps, on this side and on that side. Nothing like this had been made for any kingdom.
verses.10:21: And all the vessels made by Solomon were gold, and golden basins; all the vessels of the forest of the house of Lebanon were encased in gold; there was no silver, because it was not taken into account in the days of Solomon.
verses.10:22: For the king had a ship of Tarshish on the sea with the ships of Hiram; once every three years a ship came to the king from Tarshish with gold and silver and carved and hewn stones. This was the matter of the requisition which King Solomon raised to build the house of the Lord and the house of the king and the wall of Jerusalem and the citadel, to fence around the enclosure of the city of David, and Asshur and Midian and Gezer and Upper Beth-horon and Jethermath, and all the cities of the chariots and all the cities of the horsemen, and the undertaking of Solomon which he undertook to build in Jerusalem and in all the land, so that all the people indicated by the Hittite and the Amorite and the Perizzite and the Canaanite and the Hivite and the Jebusite and the Girgashite, those who were not of the sons of Israel, might not rule over him. Their children who were left behind after them in the land, whom the sons of Israel were not able to utterly destroy, Solomon brought up to tribute until this day. And of the sons of Israel Solomon did not assign a task, because they were the warrior men, and his servants, and commanders of his chariots, and his horsemen.
verses.10:23: And Solomon was magnified above all the kings in wealth and in understanding.
verses.10:24: And all the kings of the earth were seeking the presence of Solomon to hear his understanding, which the Lord had given to his heart.
verses.10:25: And they were bringing, each one his gifts: vessels of gold and apparel, oil of myrrh and spices, and horses and mules, year by year.
verses.10:26: And Solomon had four thousand mares for chariots and twelve thousand horsemen, and he placed them in the cities of the chariots and with the king in Jerusalem. And he was ruler of all the kings from the river even to the land of the foreigners and to the borders of Egypt.
verses.10:27: And the king made the gold and the silver in Jerusalem like stones, and the cedars he made like the sycamore trees that are in the lowland in abundance.
verses.10:28: And Solomon's export of horsemen was also from Egypt, and the merchants of the king were from Tekoa, and he received them from Tekoa in exchange;
verses.10:29: and the export came up from Egypt: a chariot for one hundred pieces of silver, and a horse for fifty pieces of silver. And in this way for all the kings of the Hittites and the kings of Syria they went out by sea.
verses.11:1: And King Solomon was a lover of women, and he had seven hundred princesses and three hundred concubines; and he took foreign wives, and the daughter of Pharaoh: Moabites, Ammonites, Syrians and Idumeans, Hittites and Amorites.
verses.11:2: From the nations concerning which the Lord had forbidden the sons of Israel, "You shall not go in to them, and they shall not go in to you, so that they do not turn your hearts aside after their idols," to them Solomon clung in love.
verses.11:4: And it happened in the time of Solomon's old age that his heart was not complete with the Lord his God, as was the heart of David his father; and the foreign wives turned his heart aside after their gods.
verses.11:5: Then Solomon built a high place for Chemosh, the idol of Moab, and for their king, the idol of the sons of Ammon,
verses.11:6: and for Astarte, the abomination of the Sidonians.
verses.11:7: And so he did for all his foreign wives; they burned incense and sacrificed to their idols.
verses.11:8: And Solomon did what was evil in the sight of the Lord; he did not walk after the Lord as David his father did.
verses.11:9: And the Lord became angry with Solomon, because he turned his heart aside from the Lord, the God of Israel, who had appeared to him twice
verses.11:10: and had commanded him concerning this matter not at all to walk after other gods, and to take care to do what the Lord God had commanded him; nor was his heart complete with the Lord, according to the heart of David his father.
verses.11:11: And the Lord said to Solomon, "Because these things have happened with you and you have not kept My commandments and My statutes which I commanded you, I will surely tear your kingdom from your hand and give it to your servant.
verses.11:12: However, in your days I will not do these things, for the sake of David your father; from the hand of your son I will take it.
verses.11:13: However, I will certainly not take the whole kingdom; I will give one tribe to your son for the sake of David My servant and for the sake of Jerusalem, the city that I have chosen."
verses.11:14: And the Lord raised up an adversary against Solomon: Hader the Idumean, and Hesrom son of Eliada, the one in Raemmaer, Hadrazar king of Zobah, his lord. And men gathered to him, and he was commander of a band, and he seized Damascus; and they were an adversary to Israel all the days of Solomon. And Hader the Idumean was of the seed of the kingdom in Idumea.
verses.11:15: And it happened, when David utterly destroyed Edom, when Joab the commander of the army went to bury the fallen, that they struck down every male in Idumea;
verses.11:16: for six months Joab and all Israel remained there in Idumea, until he had utterly destroyed every male in Idumea.
verses.11:17: And Hader fled, he and all the Idumeans of his father's servants with him, and they went into Egypt; and Hader was a little boy.
verses.11:18: And men arose from the city of Midian and came to Paran, and they took men with them and came to Pharaoh king of Egypt; and Hader went in to Pharaoh, and he gave him a house and appointed bread for him.
verses.11:19: And Hader found great favor in the sight of Pharaoh, and he gave him as a wife the sister of his own wife, the sister of Thekemina the elder. And the sister of Thekemina bore to him, to Hader, Genubath her son;
verses.11:20: and Thekemina brought him up in the midst of the sons of Pharaoh, and Genubath was in the midst of the sons of Pharaoh.
verses.11:21: And Hader heard in Egypt that David had slept with his fathers, and that Joab the commander of the army was dead; and Hader said to Pharaoh, "Send me away, and I will return to my land."
verses.11:22: And Pharaoh said to Hader, "What do you lack with me, and look, you seek to depart to your land?" And Hader said to him, "Yet you must surely send me away." And Hader returned to his land.
verses.11:25: This was the evil that Hader did: he was indignant with Israel, and he reigned in Edom.
verses.11:26: And Jeroboam son of Nebat, the Ephrathite from Sareira, the son of a widow woman, was the servant of Solomon.
verses.11:27: And this is the matter of how he lifted up his hands against the king. Solomon built the citadel; he closed up the enclosure of the city of David his father.
verses.11:28: And the man Jeroboam was mighty in strength; and Solomon saw the young man, that he was a man of works, and he appointed him over the levies of the house of Joseph.
verses.11:29: And it happened at that time that Jeroboam went out from Jerusalem, and Ahijah the Shilonite, the prophet, found him on the road, and drew him aside from the road; and Ahijah was wrapped in a new garment, and both of them were in the field.
verses.11:30: And Ahijah took hold of his new garment that was on him and tore it into twelve torn pieces;
verses.11:31: and he said to Jeroboam, "Take for yourself ten torn pieces, for thus says the Lord, the God of Israel: 'Look, I am tearing the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon, and I will give you ten tribes;
verses.11:32: and two tribes will belong to him for the sake of David My servant and for the sake of Jerusalem, the city that I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel;
verses.11:33: because he has forsaken Me, and has sacrificed to Astarte, the abomination of the Sidonians, and to Chemosh and among the idols of Moab, and to their king, the detestable thing of the sons of Ammon, and has not walked in My ways to do what is right in My sight, as David his father did.
verses.11:34: And I will certainly not take the whole kingdom out of his hand, because I will surely oppose him all the days of his life, for the sake of David My servant whom I chose.
verses.11:35: And I will take the kingdom out of the hand of his son, and I will give you the ten tribes;
verses.11:36: but to his son I will give the two tribes, so that there may be a position for My servant David all the days before Me in Jerusalem, the city that I have chosen for Myself to place My name there.
verses.11:37: And I will take you, and you shall reign over what your soul desires, and you shall be king over Israel.
verses.11:38: And it will be, if you keep everything that I command you, and walk in My ways, and do what is right in My sight by keeping My commandments and My statutes, just as David My servant did, then I will be with you and build for you a faithful house, just as I built for David.'"
verses.11:40: And Solomon sought to put Jeroboam to death; and he arose and withdrew and fled to Egypt, to Shishak king of Egypt, and he was in Egypt until Solomon died.
verses.11:41: And the rest of the acts of Solomon, and everything that he did, and all his understanding, look, are these not written in the book of the acts of Solomon?
verses.11:42: And the days that Solomon reigned in Jerusalem were forty years.
verses.11:43: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David his father. And it happened, when Jeroboam son of Nebat heard, while he was still in Egypt, since he had fled from the presence of Solomon and was living in Egypt, that he went straight on; and he came to his city, to the land of Sareira in the hill country of Ephraim. And King Solomon slept with his fathers, and Rehoboam his son reigned in his place.
verses.12:1: And King Rehoboam went to Shechem, for all Israel were coming to Shechem to make him king.
verses.12:3: And the people spoke to King Rehoboam, saying,
verses.12:4: "Your father made our yoke heavy; and now you lighten the harsh service of your father and his heavy yoke that he laid on us, and we will serve you."
verses.12:5: And he said to them, "Go away for three days, and return to me." And they went away.
verses.12:6: And the king summoned the elders, who had been standing before Solomon his father while he was still alive, saying, "How do you advise that I answer this people with a word?"
verses.12:7: And they spoke to him, saying, "If on this day you will be a servant to this people, and serve them, and speak good words to them, then they will be servants to you all the days."
verses.12:8: And he abandoned the counsel of the elders which they had counseled him, and took counsel with the young men who had been brought up with him, who stood in his presence,
verses.12:9: and said to them, "What do you advise? And what shall I answer this people who have spoken to me, saying, 'Lighten the yoke that your father put on us'?"
verses.12:10: And the young men who had been brought up with him, who stood in his presence, spoke to him, saying, "Thus you shall speak to this people who spoke to you, saying, 'Your father made our yoke heavy, and now you lighten it from us'; thus you shall speak to them: 'My littleness is thicker than my father's waist.
verses.12:11: And now my father loaded you with a heavy yoke, and I will add to your yoke; my father disciplined you with whips, but I will discipline you with scorpions.'"
verses.12:12: And all Israel came to King Rehoboam on the third day, just as the king had spoken to them, saying, "Return to me on the third day."
verses.12:13: And the king answered the people harshly, and Rehoboam abandoned the counsel of the elders which they had counseled him,
verses.12:14: and spoke to them according to the counsel of the young men, saying, "My father made your yoke heavy, and I will add to your yoke; my father disciplined you with whips, and I will discipline you with scorpions."
verses.12:15: And the king did not listen to the people, for it was a turn of events from the Lord, so that He might establish His word that He spoke by the hand of Ahijah the Shilonite concerning Jeroboam son of Nebat.
verses.12:16: And all Israel saw that the king did not listen to them; and the people answered the king, saying, "What portion do we have in David? And we have no inheritance in the son of Jesse! Run off, Israel, to your tents; now feed your house, David!" And Israel went away to their tents.
verses.12:18: And the king sent Aram, who was over the tribute, and they stoned him with stones, and he died; and King Rehoboam hurried to go up to flee to Jerusalem.
verses.12:19: And Israel has rebelled against the house of David to this day.
verses.12:20: And it happened, when all Israel heard that Rehoboam had returned, that they sent and called him to the assembly, and they made him king over Israel; and there was no one following David except the tribe of Judah and Benjamin alone.
verses.12:21: And Rehoboam entered into Jerusalem, and he assembled the assembly of Judah and the tribe of Benjamin, one hundred and twenty thousand young men making war, to fight against the house of Israel, to restore the kingdom to Rehoboam son of Solomon.
verses.12:22: And the word of the Lord came to Shemaiah, a man of God, saying,
verses.12:23: "Speak to Rehoboam son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all the house of Judah and Benjamin, and to the rest of the people, saying,
verses.12:24: 'Thus says the Lord: You shall not go up nor fight with your brothers, the sons of Israel; let each one return to his own house, for this matter has come from Me.'" And they listened to the word of the Lord, and they ceased from going, according to the word of the Lord. And King Solomon slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David; and Rehoboam his son reigned in his place in Jerusalem, being sixteen years old when he became king; and he reigned twelve years in Jerusalem. And the name of his mother was Naanan, the daughter of Ana son of Nahash, king of Ammon; and he did what was evil in the sight of the Lord and did not walk in the way of David his father. And there was a man from the hill country of Ephraim, a servant to Solomon, and his name was Jeroboam, and the name of his mother was Sareisa, a prostitute; and Solomon set him as commander of the rod over the levies of the house of Joseph. And Solomon built Sareira, which is in the hill country of Ephraim, and he had three hundred chariots of horses; this man built the citadel with the levies of the house of Ephraim; this man enclosed the city of David, and he was lifting himself up against the kingdom. And Solomon was seeking to put him to death; and he was afraid, and he himself fled to Shishak king of Egypt, and he was with him until Solomon died. And Jeroboam heard in Egypt that Solomon was dead, and he spoke in the ears of Shishak king of Egypt, saying, "Send me away, and I will go away to my land." And Shishak said to him, "Ask any request, and I will give it to you." And Shishak gave to Jeroboam Ano, the elder sister of Thekemina his wife, to him as a wife; she was the great one among the daughters of the king, and she bore to Jeroboam Abijah his son. And Jeroboam said to Shishak, "Indeed, send me away, and I will go away." And Jeroboam went out from Egypt and came to the land of Sareira, which is in the hill country of Ephraim; and the whole tribe of Ephraim gathered there; and Jeroboam built a fortification there. And his child fell sick with a very severe sickness; and Jeroboam went to inquire concerning the child; and he said to Ano his wife, "Arise, go; inquire of God concerning the child, whether he will live from his sickness." Now there was a man in Shiloh and his name was Ahijah, and this man was sixty years old, and the word of the Lord was with him. And Jeroboam said to his wife, "Arise and take in your hand for the man of God loaves of bread, and cakes for his children, and grapes, and a jar of honey." And the woman arose and took in her hand loaves of bread and two cakes and grapes and a jar of honey for Ahijah; and the man was elderly, and his eyes were too dim to see. And she arose from Sareira and went; and it happened, when she came into the city to Ahijah the Shilonite, that Ahijah said to his young servant, "Go out now to meet Ano the wife of Jeroboam, and you shall say to her, 'Come in and do not stand still, for thus says the Lord: I am sending harsh things upon you.'" And Ano went in to the man of God, and Ahijah said to her, "Why have you brought me loaves of bread and grapes and cakes and a jar of honey? Thus says the Lord: Look, you will go away from me, and it will happen when you enter the gate into Sareira that your maidservants will come out to meet you and will say to you, 'The child is dead.' For thus says the Lord: Look, I will utterly destroy from Jeroboam anyone who urinates against a wall; and it will be that those of Jeroboam who die in the city, the dogs will devour, and the one who dies in the field, the birds of the sky will devour. And the child will be mourned, 'Woe, lord!' because a good thing was found in him concerning the Lord." And the woman went away when she heard; and it happened, as she entered into Sareira, that the child died, and the outcry went out to meet her. And Jeroboam went to Shechem, which is in the hill country of Ephraim, and gathered the tribes of Israel there, and Rehoboam son of Solomon went up there. And the word of the Lord came to Shemaiah the Enlamite, saying, "Take for yourself a new garment that has not entered into water, and tear it into twelve torn pieces; and you shall give them to Jeroboam, and you shall say to him, 'Thus says the Lord: Take for yourself twelve torn pieces to wrap around yourself.'" And Jeroboam took them; and Shemaiah said, "Thus says the Lord over the ten tribes of Israel." And the people said to Rehoboam son of Solomon, "Your father made his yoke heavy upon us, and made heavy the food of his table; and now you shall lighten it upon us, and we will serve you." And Rehoboam said to the people, "Three more days, and I will answer you a word." And Rehoboam said, "Bring the elders in to me, and I will take counsel with them as to what word I should answer the people on the third day." And Rehoboam spoke in their ears just as the people had sent to him; and the elders of the people said, "Thus the people have spoken to you." And Rehoboam rejected their counsel, and it was not pleasing in his sight; and he sent and brought in his companions, and he spoke the same things to them: "These things also the people sent to me, saying."
